decisions.evidence: Putting the six comparisons together, the three mutagenic neighbors all align with the query’s higher ring count, higher aromatic carbocycle count, and generally more hydrophobic profile, while the three non-mutagenic neighbors are still outmatched by the query’s greater aromaticity and ring richness. The repeated pattern across both positive and negative neighbors is that the query sits on the more aromatic, more ring-rich side of the local chemical space, which is more compatible with option (B): is mutagenic.
